entries.name: Moira
entries.summary: Moira is a lightweight open-source newsroom computer system for broadcast bulletins, delivered as a single-page web app with a Firestore database. It keeps persistent story records with reporter/presenter assignment, format, duration and script; gives producers a running order they can drag or move up/down; and computes each story's on-air clock time and the bulletin's backtime from the TX start and story durations. It also provides live On Air/Preview Next views, a presenter/autocue view and optional radio or OBS playout.
features: Persistent story records in Firestore with slug, format, reporter, presenter, duration, script and media file
Real-time multi-user collaboration through Firestore, with per-browser anonymous sessions
Producer-managed running order with drag-and-drop and up/down reordering
Per-story on-air clock times accumulated from the bulletin TX start and story durations
Live TX mode with On Air / Preview Next cards and backtime against the scheduled end
Producer, Reporter and Presenter roles; per-newsroom story formats and rundown locking
Floated stories kept in the rundown but excluded from the timed running order
Presenter/autocue view and optional radio or OBS playout
Trash and restore for deleted stories
deployment: Single HTML file opened in a browser and distributable from a shared folder with a media subfolder
Cloud sync through a Firebase/Firestore project; reporters collaborate in a real-time digital newsroom from any internet-connected machine, with a non-persistent local mode when unconfigured
Optional radio or OBS playout from the browser
